intro.cap: CareCircle: voice-first care for the people we love
intro.say: Millions of families look after an older parent from far away. CareCircle gives that parent a voice assistant, and gives the family a calm, trustworthy picture.

start.cap: Six synthetic families, 29 accounts, four roles. Start the demo.
start.say: Six synthetic families, twenty nine accounts, four roles. Let's start the demo.

asha.cap: Asha, 78, has type 2 diabetes. She just talks to Alexa.
asha.say: Asha is seventy eight, and has type two diabetes. She simply talks to Alexa.

tools.cap: Alexa picks the tools: log the dose, record the reading, check the trend
tools.say: Alexa chooses the tools. It logs the dose, records the sugar reading, and checks the trend.

mcp.cap: Every call goes through the MCP server: permission-checked, patient-bound, audited
mcp.say: Every call goes through our M C P server. Each one is permission checked, bound to this one patient, and audited.

family.cap: Her son Rohan sees it instantly in the family app
family.say: Her son Rohan sees it instantly, in the family app.

safety.cap: Safety is code, not luck: emergencies are never left to the model
safety.say: Safety is code, not luck. Emergencies are never left to the model.

fall.cap: The server speaks a fixed 112 / 108 message and raises an urgent alert
fall.say: The server speaks a fixed one one two, one zero eight message, and raises an urgent alert. It never claims that help is on the way.

watch.cap: Autonomous care watch: reviews the whole record and decides who needs to know
watch.say: The autonomous care watch reviews the whole record, and decides who needs to know.

langs.cap: Seven languages. Alexa+ in India covers English, Hindi and Hinglish today.
langs.say: Seven languages. Alexa plus in India covers English, Hindi and Hinglish today.

admin.cap: Family admins manage the care plan. New prescription? Just photograph it.
admin.say: Family admins manage the care plan. A new prescription? Just photograph it.

scan.cap: The model reads it into a draft. Nothing is added until a person confirms.
scan.say: The model reads it into a draft. Nothing is added until a person confirms.

checks.cap: Allergy conflicts and duplicates are caught by code, not by the model
checks.say: Code, not the model, checks for allergy conflicts and duplicates.

audit.cap: Every action is audited. Families only ever see their own people.
audit.say: Every action is audited, and families only ever see their own people.

outro.cap: CareCircle · built for Alexa+ with an MCP server · MIT · github.com/Shivprasadhule/carecircle
outro.say: CareCircle. Built for Alexa plus on an M C P server. Open source, M I T, on Git Hub.
